svg.text: Submit Survey for Approval (assigned Survey Engineer)
Validate cookie + CSRF + check active survey assignment
Approve Survey (Admin or owning PM, not the creator)
Validate cookie + CSRF + check role (Admin or owning PM)
Guard: reviewer must not be the survey's creator
Validate cookie + CSRF + check role, not creator
Archive Survey (only from APPROVED or REJECTED)
Guard: status must be APPROVED or REJECTED
- Reviewer attempts to approve/reject own submission: 403
- Archive from a status other than APPROVED/REJECTED: 400
- Unsafe request without valid CSRF token: 403 CSRF_FAILURE
- Exactly one Approval record exists per survey; approve
and reject always UPDATE that record, never insert a
- ApprovalHistory is append-only and grows with every
- Access Control Module enforces 'cannot review own
survey' before Approvals Module is even called
- Auth is via HttpOnly cookie, not an Authorization header
- Dashed orange box: Drone Mapping Service boundary
- Colored modules inside the box are internal
